traditional: No classical doctrine: Chiron is a modern point. This combination is modern only.

modern.blend: Identity meets the old wound around worth and belonging. Being seen touches a tender place about whether one is truly valued.
modern.harmonious: The wound becomes a source of compassion and quiet teaching; being recognized helps heal what once went unseen.
modern.hard: Recognition reopens the sore spot: praise arrives but does not reach the deeper doubt about worth.
modern.business: Creative, healing, or teaching directions where the wound is worked in the open; guard against needing endless validation.

provenance.modern: Chiron as the self-worth wound (Cartwright, Beyond Doorways); Sun as identity and recognition. STUB, needs owner review and a second Chiron source for depth.
